text: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund has bankrolled LIV Golf since its 2022 launch and said on 30 April 2026 that the 'substantial investment required is no longer consistent' with its strategy and that it will stop funding the league at the end of the 2026 season; reported spend is c. $5bn to date, rising to c. $6bn by the end of 2026, and PIF governor and LIV chairman Yasir Al-Rumayyan is expected to step down.
short: PIF has funded LIV Golf since 2022 and is ending its funding after the 2026 season (c. $5-6bn reported spend).
